tina wong: Hey folks, newbie question - I'm trying to run a live demo with streaming output. Which key should I be using locally? I tried my hosted key but it's rate limited by CI projects.

omar siddiq: welcome! use the SANDBOX key for manual demos. Hosted keys are for CI/staging. Sandbox has lower limits so slow down loops or you'll see 429s.

kevin li: fyi streaming behind corp proxy often hangs after first chunk. If you're on mac/linux try: 
```
curl --no-buffer -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"hi","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```
or test from your phone hotspot to rule out proxy.

infra-bot: ACTION: sandbox-quota-request created (#SAND-903). Please include last 6 of key + expected daily token usage.

tina wong: thanks — filed the ticket and added last6 + ~20k/day estimate. One more: for quick local dev should I use sandbox or generate ephemeral hosted tokens?

omar siddiq: sandbox for interactive dev. Ephemeral hosted tokens are overkill unless you need exact hosted env.

tina wong: perfect, thanks all :)
